Teaching focus

Proposed in 1937 to explain emotion, the loop is now studied mainly for memory, navigation and attention, and as part of broader cortical networks.

2022–2026 updates

The anterior thalamic nuclei are active network hubs, not passive relays. Distinct subdomains connect to different cognitive and emotional systems, and episodic memory depends on distributed, recurrent networks.

Evidence and further reading
